model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B frozen text-only final-token features plus a CPU logistic head
interpretation: With the same frozen cases, prompt, backbone, head-fitting procedure, and calibration-only cutoffs, screenshots did not improve the cautious operating point: visual 3 false allowances and 21 false warnings versus text-only 2 and 18. This small retrospective comparison does not prove that visual evidence is useless or generalize to live desktops. Neither head is safe to promote.
gpu_stability: The 256-case text-only extraction completed on RTX 4060 at 4.208 GiB peak allocated VRAM without a CUDA error; prior visual extraction did encounter a driver-associated CUDA fault.
